steps.code:
# Get all transactions for May 2023 (this month)
access_token = login_result['access_token']
transactions = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print("Error:", page)
        break
    transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Number of transactions in May:", len(transactions))
# Print first few to see structure
for t in transactions[:3]:
    print(t)
